title: AB potential difference
description: Essential: Correctly calculates U_AB = W_AB/q, obtaining 100 V.

title: BC potential difference
description: Essential: Correctly calculates U_BC = W_BC/q, obtaining -300 V.

title: AC potential difference
description: Essential: Correctly sums U_AB + U_BC to obtain -200 V.

title: Potential at C
description: Important: Uses φ_A = 0 and U_AC = φ_A - φ_C to find φ_C = 200 V.

title: Potential energy at C
description: Essential: Calculates E_C = qφ_C, obtaining -4×10⁻⁷ J.

title: Sign handling
description: Pitfall: Misinterprets sign of work or charge, leading to wrong potential signs.

title: Potential difference definition
description: Important: Applies ΔV = W/q consistently for both segments.

title: Additivity reasoning
description: Important: Recognizes that potential differences add: U_AC = U_AB + U_BC.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains correct units (V for potential, J for energy) throughout.
